title: What is MCP?

body.text: a standard for connecting AI to external tools and data
— like USB for the AI world: write an MCP server once and it works with any app that supports it, no custom integration needed.

example: "A Postgres MCP server lets Claude talk to the database / a Slack one lets it read and send messages"

title: What MCP changes in your workflow

body.text: Once Claude Code connects MCP, it can
work across systems in a single sentence
— like reading a GitHub issue, checking real data in the database, then editing the code to match, with no copy-pasting across screens.

example: "'Read issue #42 and fix the bug, checking the real data in the users table too' — done in one command"
